small white car with roof pod on the street
brown floodwater spreading rightward over the dark asphalt
caption box at the curb line just under the car
actions: brown water front advances from left of the car to the right edge of the frame between 18.0 and 18.4 s, covering the whole street
water rises from wheel bottoms to above the wheel arches by 18.6 s
car shifts slightly right between 18.0 and 18.4 s then holds
text: Illustration. Another car, earlier in April
Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater.
observed: 18.0 to 18.8 s. Brown floodwater spreads rightward until it covers the whole street by 18.4 s, then rises from the wheel bottoms to above the wheel arches by 18.6 s. The small white car sits in it, moving slightly right early then holding. House, live oak and street sign behind; plain pale sidewalk occupies the bottom third. No hazard lamp blinking is distinguishable at this size.
